name: Please Be Quiet Nashville 2025
information:
Join us as we bring another competition back to Nashville, TN! Please read all tabs!

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.**
